label: This follows up subsistent infinity reception audit 20261031 for issue #354
summary:
This follows up ATTEMPT-SUBSISTENT-INFINITY-RECEPTION-AUDIT-20261031 for issue #354. It takes that audit's three design obligations as explicit typed premises rather than waiting for their independent defense. AQUINAS-ST-I-Q7-A1, AQUINAS-ST-I-Q7-A2 and AQUINAS-DE-ENTE-C3-4 were materialized and reread. Two new relations are indexed to a thing's esse: EsseReceivedIn x r (x's esse is received in principle r) and EsseLimited x. A third, ReceptivePotencyTo p a, is the potency of a recipient that may already have its act; it is not the legacy InPotency.

Obligation (1), why identity of essence and esse excludes reception, is split into three premises:
- reception only in the thing's own essence: unattributed, since De ente c.4 [69875] and q.7 a.2 state it only for created intellectual substances and subsistent created forms;
- a receiver is in receptive potency to the received esse: De ente c.3 [69874], sourced;
- nothing is in receptive potency to itself: unattributed, since c.3 does not say that the correlation requires two principles.

Obligation (2), receiver exhaustion, is the q.7 a.1 warrant restricted to esse: limited esse is received. Obligation (3), the adapter to the old primitive Infinite, comes from q.7 a.1 'infinitum dicitur ... non est finitum' with a.2: unlimited esse suffices for Infinite.

The EXACT legacy SubsistentBeingIsInfiniteReading is derived with zero axioms. Six Unit/Bool interpretations show that each premise is needed and that the five are jointly satisfiable. The legacy not-both act/potency law and Composite are not used. Codex review on #976 (two P1s) moved the two generalizations out of source claims and made them unattributed premises.

Definition-fork follow-up (2026-11-06): inspected the original proof and source objection. New EsseReceptionDefinitionFork keeps actual union, whole/soul/recipient role maps, communication, same-act identity, interpretation transfer, recipient inequality and scope membership independent. Eleven checked results expose local/global forks, exact conditional broad/restricted counterexamples, six omission/sense controls, and a strict identity-scoped weakening. The old infinity proof only uses own-essence reception for esse=essence bearers; importing it on that subtype reaches the EXACT old target with this weaker law. A new finite profile has a nonidentity reception counterexample and a separate identity candidate while the weaker law holds; it does not claim all other infinity premises. Rejected arbitrary soul exclusion, communication=reception by terminology, forgetting act identity or actual union, and replacing soul essence by whole-human essence. Source statement/claim senses and all prior Challenges remain unchanged; new interpretation attribution deferred. Full boundaries in docs/notes/esse-reception-definition-fork.md.

Bounded infinity-sense/root-consumer audit (2026-11-09, issues #354/#1233): inspected the exact GodIsInfinite.godIsInfinite consumer, SubsistentInfinityFromReception.subsistentBeingIsInfinite, SubsistentInfinityReceptionControls.checks, EsseReceptionDefinitions.InfinityFromIdentityScope.infinityFromIdentityScope, InfinityReception definitions, and the InfiniteGreatestWhole note/model. Rejected duplicate identity-to-infinity and cardinality-versus-perfection proof candidates: the first already reaches the exact legacy SubsistentBeingIsInfiniteReading (including an identity-scoped own-essence weakening), and the second already has mathematical region/interval controls distinguishing cardinality, coordinate extent, greatestness, restricted-family maximality and no-maximal-degree ascent. These controls do not model qualitative completeness as an internally interpreted perfection. The actual classical-attributes consumer takes the same primitive Infinite parameter and hInfinity; neither order-theoretic greatestness nor an infinite carrier can instantiate it without an explicit semantic bridge. INFINITE_1 currently names GodIsInfinite, a proposition parameterized by predicates, rather than a distinct sense type; INFINITE_2 has no lean_declaration. Neither coverage/exclusivity premises nor a certified joint fork occur in the infinity disambiguation. This is an unfinished semantic fork, not a new proof obligation discharged by a renamed wrapper. No new result, source attribution, proposition meaning, frozen Challenge or premise is changed. No pending logic-strengthening module is imported.
blocker: All five premises are open. Two are bare and unattributed: reception only in the thing's own essence, and no self-receptive potency. Three are sourced but undefended. Whether every limitation of esse comes from reception is not argued in q.7 a.1. A rival who posits a self-receiving esse, or a limited unreceived esse, is modelled here, not refuted. A source for either unattributed premise in its general form would make them sourced. One candidate is SCG I.43 ('omnis actus alteri inhaerens terminationem recipit ex eo in quo est'), but no witness for it is pinned yet. Semantic next step: choose an internally interpreted qualitative-perfection domain and candidate-relative limitation criterion that distinguishes finite qualitative completeness from absence of every relevant limit; bind it to distinct infinity sense types, then expose its applicability and adapter to the SAME primitive Infinite used by GodIsInfinite as explicit open premises. The existing order controls do not supply that interpretation, and replacing EsseLimited by an opaque completeness flag would only relocate it. Coverage and exclusivity of the proposed senses also remain open. This audit adds no premise discharge.
